build_system: go build, go test (standard Go toolchain)
test_framework: Go standard testing package with inline mock data and table-driven tests
verification_instructions: 1. Run go build ./... to confirm compilation. 2. Run go test ./internal/sbom/... -v -count=1 to confirm all tests pass.
setup_instructions: Go 1.26.5 is available. gopkg.in/yaml.v3 and encoding/xml are already available (yaml.v3 in go.mod, encoding/xml in stdlib). No additional setup needed.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Go 1.26.5 available. No Docker needed for tests.
contribution_requirements: Tests use inline mock data (no testdata files). Table-driven tests preferred. Test mocks should be self-created based on official format structures.
key_patterns: Parse(data []byte) is the main entry point. detectFormat() identifies format. Each format has its own file (cyclonedx.go, spdx.go) with typed structs and a parse function. Components without purl are skipped. resolveComponent() converts purl string to Component. XML structs use encoding/xml tags. YAML uses gopkg.in/yaml.v3 struct tags.
directory_structure: internal/sbom/ - SBOM parsing package with format detection and per-format parsers. internal/purl/ - Package URL parsing utilities. All source in Go.
